strings.zh: 欢迎来到战斗工厂！{SCROLL}在这里可以独自游玩。{NEWLINE}现在给您说明{CLEAR}单人战斗和双人战斗的情况！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Factory!{SCROLL}Here, you can play on your own.{NEWLINE}Let me explain the Single Battle{CLEAR}and Double Battle challenges!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: older variant of the Factory reception bank 0105 (probably unused); 交替战斗 rendered Swap Battle.

strings.en: Which one would you like to challenge?

strings.zh: 这里正在进行使用出租精灵{NEWLINE}来对战的战斗。{SCROLL}首先要借用战斗工厂专用的精灵！{SCROLL}接着使用那只精灵进行战斗！{SCROLL}只要在战斗中获胜一次{CLEAR}就可以交换精灵！{SCROLL}如此边交换边战斗,{NEWLINE}如果您能出色地连胜７场战斗,{CLEAR}就赠予您战斗点！{SCROLL}如果打算暂时中断挑战的话{CLEAR}请保存好进度,{CLEAR}不然下次就无法继续挑战了！{SCROLL}请务必注意！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Here, we hold battles{NEWLINE}using rental Pokémon.{SCROLL}First, you rent Pokémon made{NEWLINE}just for the Battle Factory!{SCROLL}Then you battle with those Pokémon!{SCROLL}Win just one battle, and{NEWLINE}you can trade Pokémon!{SCROLL}Keep trading and battling, and{NEWLINE}if you win 7 battles in a row,{CLEAR}you’ll be given Battle Points!{SCROLL}If you want to take a break from your{NEWLINE}challenge, please save, or you won’t{CLEAR}be able to continue it next time!{SCROLL}Please be careful!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 欢迎来到战斗工厂！{SCROLL}下面由我来介绍能和朋友{NEWLINE}通信进行游戏的多人战！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome to the Battle Factory!{SCROLL}Let me introduce the Multi Battle,{NEWLINE}which you can play with a friend by link!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你要挑战{NEWLINE}交替战斗对战吗？
strings.en: Will you take the Swap Battle challenge?

strings.zh: 这里正在举行使用{NEWLINE}出租精灵对战的{CLEAR}交替战斗,对战。{SCROLL}首先要借用２只交替战斗{NEWLINE}专用的精灵！{SCROLL}接着使用那两只的精灵{CLEAR}进行双人战斗！{SCROLL}如果在战斗中获胜{NEWLINE}就会有一次交换{CLEAR}精灵的机会！{SCROLL}允许交换的一方是自己{NEWLINE}或者是朋友。{SCROLL}就这样边交换边战斗,{NEWLINE}如果您出色地连胜７场战斗{CLEAR}就赠与您战斗点！{SCROLL}另外交替战斗,对战是不能{CLEAR}中途退出的！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Here, we hold Swap Battles{NEWLINE}using rental Pokémon.{SCROLL}First, you rent 2 Pokémon{NEWLINE}made just for Swap Battles!{SCROLL}Then you use those two{NEWLINE}Pokémon in Double Battles!{SCROLL}If you win a battle, you get{NEWLINE}one chance to trade Pokémon!{SCROLL}The one who may trade is{NEWLINE}either you or your friend.{SCROLL}Keep trading and battling, and{NEWLINE}if you win 7 battles in a row,{CLEAR}you’ll be given Battle Points!{SCROLL}Also, you can’t quit a Swap{NEWLINE}Battle partway through!{SCROLL}
We look forward to your next visit!

strings.zh: ５０级和无限制{NEWLINE}你要挑战哪种呢？
strings.en: Which will you challenge: the{NEWLINE}Level 50 or the Open Level class?

strings.zh: 带您参观之前{NEWLINE}可以先保存进度吗？
strings.en: May I save your progress{NEWLINE}before showing you in?
Right this way, please!
We look forward to your next visit!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 恭候多时！{SCROLL}在继续挑战之前{NEWLINE}请先保存进度！
strings.en: We’ve been expecting you!{SCROLL}Please save your progress{NEWLINE}before continuing your challenge!

strings.zh: 这位客人！{SCROLL}上次没有保存进度{CLEAR}就退出比赛了吧？{SCROLL}要重新挑战的话,请到对面！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Excuse me!{SCROLL}You quit your last challenge{NEWLINE}without saving, didn’t you?{SCROLL}If you want to challenge again, please{NEWLINE}go to the counter across the way!{SCROLL}
Here is information on{NEWLINE}your commemorative gift.
